scope: Bounded exact-recipient inbox listing with current privacy and source target authorization

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

policy.ownership_scope: exact non-nil tenant and recipient identities
policy.page_bound: 20 rows by default and 64 rows maximum
policy.ordering: created_at descending then notification id descending
policy.cursor: versioned full timestamp seconds and nanoseconds plus non-nil UUID tie-breaker
policy.cursor_bound: non-empty control-free cursor capped at 128 bytes before parsing
policy.raw_scan: read at most bounded limit plus one before authorization filtering
policy.authorization_composition: each scanned row delegates to NotificationInboxOpenService
policy.privacy: current recipient policy suppression removes the row without exposing the reason
policy.source_target: current source target unavailability removes the row
policy.sparse_page: an empty returned page may carry a next cursor
policy.cursor_progress: derive the next cursor from the last scanned raw row rather than the last returned item
policy.failure_atomicity: retryable privacy or source failures abort the page without a partial result
policy.read_model: return typed source type template actor priority state source-owned template data and inbox timestamps only
policy.route_boundary: listing adds no dedicated route or structural target owner kind or id fields
policy.mutation_boundary: listing does not mutate seen read archive state or delivery attempts

not_delivered: seen read and archive state mutations
search index SEO and deep-link migration
